_note: Hunter search (game/hunters/ai/hunter_brain.gd _pick_search_target_search). Standard values are the Godot DIFFICULTY_PROFILES hide_random values (game_config.gd 25-55). hiding_spot_chance: chance a search point is a hiding spot near the last sighting (checked before the random offsets). last_seen_spot_first: always check that spot first when one is in reach. unchecked_first: among reachable offsets, pick the one farthest from the points this hunter already searched in this chase (covers unchecked rooms and dead ends).
